requirements.description: The fellowship must be grounded in international mobility: researchers undertaking European Fellowships move to or within Europe; researchers undertaking Global Fellowships move to a non-associated Third Country for the outgoing phase with mandatory return to Europe.

European Postdoctoral Fellowships: open to researchers of any nationality; standard duration between 12 and 24 months; place of work in an EU Member State or Horizon Europe Associated Country (or involving mobility to Europe from any country in the world).

Global Postdoctoral Fellowships: open to European nationals or long-term residents; outgoing phase minimum 12 and maximum 24 months in a non-associated Third Country; mandatory 12-month return phase to an EU Member State or Horizon Europe Associated Country host.

Training activities implemented under the fellowship must integrate key transferable skills and competences (including digital skills such as generative AI), foster Open Science culture, knowledge valorisation, and good scientific conduct including research integrity.

A Career Development Plan covering research objectives, training and career needs, transferable skills, teaching, publications, conferences, and Open Science must be established jointly by the supervisor(s) and the researcher, and submitted as a project deliverable at the beginning of the action.

A non-academic sector placement of up to 6 additional months may optionally be included at the end of the project, in a non-academic organisation established in an EU Member State or Horizon Europe Associated Country. If included, it must be an integral part of the proposal with explicit justification of added value for the project and the researcher's career development, and is subject to evaluation.

Secondments may optionally be included within the fellowship. For European Fellowships, secondments cannot exceed half of the requested duration (excluding non-academic placement period). For Global Fellowships, optional secondments are permitted for up to half of the outgoing phase, with a maximum of three months permitted at the beneficiary at the start of the project. Secondments cannot occur during the mandatory 12-month return phase.

ERA Fellowships provide specific support for researchers undertaking their fellowship in a widening country (as defined in Work Programme Annex 11, Widening Participation and Strengthening the European Research Area), aiming to spread excellence and foster balanced brain circulation in widening countries.
